job.title: Service Engineer
job.description:
Service Engineer – Industrial Automation

Melbourne VIC


About the Company

My client is a global provider of industrial automation and control solutions, supporting manufacturers and industrial customers with technologies across automation, motion control, pneumatics and process applications.

With a strong technical focus and established presence in Australia, they provide customers with engineering support, application expertise and reliable solutions designed to improve equipment performance and productivity.


The Role

My client is seeking a Service Engineer to join their technical service team.

This is a hands-on engineering role responsible for supporting customers with the installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance and repair of industrial automation equipment and systems.

The successful candidate will work directly with customers and their equipment, diagnosing technical issues and providing practical solutions across electrical, automation and pneumatic applications. The position will suit an engineer who enjoys fault finding, customer interaction and working across a variety of industrial environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Install, commission and service industrial automation equipment.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot electrical and control system faults.
  • Support PLC programming and control system applications.
  • Troubleshoot sensors, motor controllers, servo motors and remote I/O systems.
  • Service and support pneumatic and compressed air systems.
  • Assist customers with pneumatic actuators, control valves and process valve applications.
  • Provide technical support and practical solutions to customers.
  • Conduct preventative maintenance and equipment inspections.
  • Prepare accurate service reports and technical documentation.
  • Work closely with customers and internal technical teams to resolve equipment issues.
  • Maintain a high standard of customer service, safety and technical workmanship.


About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechatronic or Electrical Engineering.
  • A Master's Degree in Mechatronic or Electrical Engineering will be highly regarded.
  • A relevant Diploma may also be considered where supported by strong practical industry experience.
  • A minimum of 3–4 years' relevant engineering or service experience, preferably within industrial automation or a similar technical environment.
  • Practical experience with control systems and PLC programming.
  • Knowledge of sensors, motor controllers, servo motors and remote I/O.
  • Good understanding of compressed air preparation, energy efficiency and pneumatic systems.
  • Exposure to pneumatic actuators, control valves and/or process valves.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
  • A customer-focused approach with good interpersonal skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • The ability to work independently while maintaining strong relationships with customers and internal teams.
  • A current Australian driver's licence and willingness to travel to customer sites as required.

﻿

What's on Offer

  • Attractive Base + Super + Bonus.
  • Opportunity to work with a global industrial automation business.
  • Exposure to a broad range of automation, electrical and pneumatic technologies.
  • Technical training and ongoing product development.
  • Work directly with customers across a variety of industrial applications.
  • Support from an experienced engineering and technical team.
  • Long-term professional development and career opportunities.

job.title: Territory Sales Representative- Isolation valves
job.description:
Territory Sales Representative – Isolation Valves

Queensland


About the Company

My client is a global provider of industrial flow control and process solutions, supplying engineered valves, actuation and associated equipment to customers across resources, chemical processing, water and other industrial markets.

With an established presence in Australia, the business is recognised for its technical expertise, quality product range and long-standing relationships with major industrial customers.


The Role

My client is seeking an experienced Territory Sales Representative to manage and grow their business across Queensland.

This is a technical sales position combining management of existing accounts with new business development. The successful candidate will work closely with end users, EPCMs, contractors and other key stakeholders to understand their applications and provide suitable valve and flow control solutions.

The role will involve regular customer and site visits, developing new opportunities, preparing commercial proposals and managing the sales process from initial enquiry through to order.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop an established Queensland sales territory.
  • Build relationships with existing customers and identify new business opportunities.
  • Promote industrial valves, actuators and flow control solutions.
  • Work with customers to understand technical and commercial requirements.
  • Develop relationships with end users, EPCMs, contractors and key stakeholders.
  • Prepare quotations, proposals and commercial offers.
  • Manage opportunities from initial enquiry through to order.
  • Conduct regular customer visits and attend site meetings.
  • Maintain sales budgets, forecasts and pipeline reporting.
  • Keep CRM records and customer information up to date.
  • Work closely with internal technical, engineering and service teams.
  • Monitor market activity, upcoming projects and competitor developments.
  • Achieve agreed sales and territory growth targets.


About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • A tertiary qualification or relevant trade background in engineering, science, business or a related discipline.
  • Previous experience in technical, industrial or engineering sales.
  • Experience working with customers across the resources, chemical processing and water industries.
  • Experience managing sales budgets, forecasting and commercial reporting.
  • Good commercial awareness with the ability to understand technical applications and key customer business drivers.
  • Experience using CRM systems to manage customer activity, opportunities and sales pipelines.
  • Previous exposure to valves, flow control, process equipment or related industrial products will be highly regarded.
  • Strong account management and new business development skills.
  • Confidence dealing with technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • The ability to work independently and effectively manage a large territory.
  • A current Australian driver's licence and willingness to travel to customer and site locations as required. 


What's on Offer

  • Attractive Base + Super + Bonus + Car Allowance.
  • Opportunity to represent a highly regarded range of industrial products and solutions.
  • Established customer base with genuine scope to grow the territory.
  • Mix of account management and new business development.
  • Exposure to major customers and projects across Queensland.
  • Strong support from experienced technical, engineering and service teams.
  • Long-term career opportunities within a global industrial organisation.

job.title: Management Accountant
job.description:

Melbourne | Food & Beverage Manufacturing


Join a global leader in food and beverage ingredients manufacturing and play a key role in driving financial performance across a dynamic manufacturing operation.

Based on the position description provided for the Management Accountant role in Melbourne.

job.title: Fitter - Flow Control Solutions
job.description:
Mechanical Fitter - Valve Services

Perth WA


About the Company

My client is an established Australian provider of severe-service valve solutions, supporting customers across the mining, power and water industries. With a strong presence in the market and decades of industry experience, the business provides specialist valve servicing, maintenance and repair solutions for demanding industrial applications.

Due to ongoing workload and growth, my client is looking for an experienced Mechanical Fitter to join their Perth workshop on a permanent, full-time basis.


The Role

This is a hands-on position suited to a mechanically minded Fitter who enjoys stripping, inspecting, repairing and rebuilding industrial equipment.

Working from the Malaga workshop, the successful candidate will be responsible for servicing a range of industrial valves and associated actuation and automation equipment while ensuring all work is completed safely and to a high standard.


Key responsibilities will include:

  • Stripping, assessing, repairing and rebuilding industrial valves
  • Servicing knife gate, ball, check, butterfly and control valves
  • Working with actuators and associated valve automation equipment
  • Reading and interpreting detailed drawings and technical specifications
  • Identifying job, material and equipment requirements
  • Completing valve inspection and service reports
  • Diagnosing mechanical issues and determining appropriate repair requirements
  • Carrying out mechanical maintenance safely and efficiently
  • Ensuring completed work meets quality and safety standards


About You


My client is looking for someone who has:

  • Mechanical Fitter or relevant trade experience
  • Ideally at least 2 years of fitting experience
  • Previous valve servicing or maintenance experience highly regarded
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and fault-finding ability
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications
  • Experience working within industrial, mining, power, water or similar environments advantageous
  • Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality
  • Good attention to detail and a reliable work ethic
  • Forklift licence advantageous
  • Australian working rights


What's on Offer


This is a permanent, full-time opportunity offering competitive hourly rates, with the potential to earn significantly more through the company's bonus structure.


My client is looking for someone interested in becoming a valued member of the team and ideally building a longer-term career within the business. The position also provides valuable exposure to specialised valve servicing and severe-service applications, making it a strong opportunity for a Fitter looking to further develop their industrial maintenance skills.


If you have strong mechanical fitting experience and are interested in developing your expertise within the industrial valve sector, apply today for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Technical Sales - Hydraulic Hose
job.description:

You will be responsible for managing an established portfolio of customers while developing new business opportunities throughout your territory. Working closely with manufacturers, OEMs, and industrial customers, you'll provide technical advice on hydraulic hoses, hose assemblies, fittings, fluid transfer products, and related industrial solutions, ensuring customers receive the right products and support for their applications.

The territory covers Brisbane Metropolitan and Toowoomba, with occasional travel to regional accounts as required.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop new business opportunities within manufacturing, OEM, and industrial markets.
  • Promote hydraulic hoses, hose fittings, fluid transfer products, and related industrial solutions.
  • Provide technical advice and product recommendations based on customer applications.
  • Prepare quotations and manage opportunities through to successful completion.
  • Build long-term customer relationships through regular site visits and a consultative sales approach.

  • Experience selling into manufacturers, OEMs, or industrial customers.
  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering or trade background highly regarded 
  • Open to Automotive mechanics, or spare parts backgrounds, seeking a move into an industrial sales role, with a leading manufacturer. A great platform to establish a career in the industry 
  • Mechanical aptitude
  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, and negotiation skills.

What's on Offer

  • Performance bonus structure.

  • Established territory with an existing customer base from day one.

job.title: Key Account Manager - Beverage

job.title: Technical Sales Engineer - Power Transmission
job.description:
Technical Sales Engineer / Power Transmission

Melbourne, VIC

The Company

My client is a global OEM specialising in industrial power transmission, rotating equipment, motion control, and mechanical drive solutions supporting manufacturing, food & beverage, packaging, materials handling, water, utilities, and heavy industrial sectors worldwide.

Their product portfolio spans gearboxes, couplings, bearings, conveyor technologies, drive systems, motion control products, and broader rotating equipment solutions utilised across critical industrial infrastructure and industrial processing environments.

Due to continued growth, they now seek a Technical Sales Engineer to join their Melbourne team, supporting major industrial customers throughout Victoria.

The Role

This position will focus on managing and developing customer relationships across Melbourne and regional Victoria, supporting a diverse customer base across manufacturing, industrial processing, materials handling, food production, utilities, and OEM markets.

Candidates can be based anywhere within the Melbourne metropolitan area.

The role will involve exposure to:

  • Manufacturing facilities
  • Food & beverage processing plants
  • Materials handling and conveyor operations
  • Packaging and production facilities
  • Water and wastewater utilities
  • OEMs and industrial machine builders
  • Industrial maintenance contractors
  • Shutdown and maintenance environments

You will work closely with Reliability Engineers, Maintenance Managers, Mechanical Engineers, Procurement teams, Plant Managers, Engineering Managers, and Operations personnel across a wide range of industrial customers throughout Victoria.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing strategic customer relationships
  • Driving rotating equipment and power transmission sales growth
  • Supporting maintenance, upgrade, and reliability projects
  • Identifying brownfield and greenfield opportunities
  • Managing key industrial customer accounts
  • Conducting regular customer and site visits
  • Providing technical and commercial product support
  • Building long-term relationships with key decision makers

About You

To be successful in this role, you will ideally possess:

  • 5+ years' sales experience within industrial, manufacturing, mechanical, or technical product environments
  • Exposure to rotating equipment, power transmission, pumps, conveyors, bearings, couplings, gearboxes, electric motors, or related industrial products
  • Strong customer relationship and business development capability
  • Practical industry knowledge and credibility with technical customers
  • Ability to confidently engage with plant-based decision makers
  • Strong commercial drive and autonomous work ethic
  • Mechanical Engineering degree, Mechanical Fitter, or trade-qualified background highly regarded
  • Hands-on experience with rotating equipment highly regarded
  • Existing manufacturing or industrial customer networks highly regarded
  • Familiarity with plant maintenance, reliability, and shutdown environments highly regarded
  • Open to mechanically minded candidates transitioning from hands-on industrial or manufacturing backgrounds into technical sales, particularly those with strong site exposure, industrial networks, and experience working within maintenance and operational environments

On Offer

  • Competitive base salary + super + attractive bonus structure
  • Fit-for-purpose company vehicle
  • Highly autonomous territory-based role
  • Exposure to leading manufacturing and industrial customers throughout Victoria
  • Long-term career opportunity with a respected global OEM
